entries.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'

entries.title: Fed expected to raise interest rates. And, board votes to close Kennedy Center
entries.snippet: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates today for the first time in three years. And, the Kennedy Center board voted yesterday to close the historic center.

entries.title: EU's Ursula von der Leyen says she wants Canada to become an associate member
entries.snippet: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Wednesday proposed making Canada the European Union's first associate member, a striking overture as U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs drive Ottawa closer to Europe.

entries.title: Senators question Trump's picks for top health positions, including surgeon general
entries.snippet: On Wednesday, the Senate committee on health holds a confirmation hearing for three top health officials, including surgeon general. Dr. Nicole Saphier is President Trump's third attempt to nominate a surgeon general.

entries.title: Kosovo's ex-President Thaci convicted of war crimes, sentenced to 25 years in prison
entries.snippet: A European Union-backed court convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes committed during his country's war for independence from Serbia and sentenced him to 25 years in prison.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia calls an attempted Mecca attack a 'red line' as Houthis deny they did it
entries.snippet: Saudi Arabia accused Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels overnight of trying to attack Islam's holiest city, prompting condemnation from countries in the region but no sign of military support.

entries.title: As campaign season gears up, AI-generated ads are everywhere
entries.snippet: Data suggests many candidates are embracing AI this year to boost their image and portray their opponents unfavorably. But whether it will turn out voters remains unclear.

entries.title: A Kansas girl ran off to join the circus and changed the tattoo world
entries.snippet: One of the country's first known female tattoo artists was born on a Kansas farm. Maud Stevens Wagner ran off to join the circus and later became a tattoo legend.

entries.title: 21 million women live in U.S. counties with limited birth control access
entries.snippet: Because of a data lag, the current reality of access may be even worse.

entries.title: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in 3 years
entries.snippet: The Fed is widely expected to raise its benchmark interest rate to combat stubborn inflation. That could make it more expensive to borrow money to buy a car or carry a balance on a credit card.

entries.title: When students attend these colleges, taxpayers often pay. Here's why
entries.snippet: Federal data shows many borrowers who aren't paying their loans went to private, for-profit colleges — schools that often market to low-income students and rely on federal financial aid for revenue.

entries.snippet: Massie said Hegseth abused his powers by deploying the U.S. military in the war against Iran without seeking congressional approval under the War Powers Act. He said these are "unlawful orders" and "high crimes and misdemeanors."

entries.title: 18-year-old dies in Pennsylvania's 4th measles-associated death
entries.snippet: The U.S. is experiencing its worst measles year since 1991, with seven deaths in two years.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Warsh holds briefing after Fed meeting as interest rates expected to rise
entries.snippet: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to lift its short-term interest rate Wednesday for the first time in three years to fight stubbornly high inflation, a move that would put the central bank at odds with President Donald Trump's support for a cut.

entries.title: WATCH: Blumenthal grills FBI Director Kash Patel on firing Iran specialists days before U.S. launched war
entries.snippet: Sen. Richard Blumenthal, D-Conn., asked FBI Director Kash Patel why he fired a dozen agents and staff members from a counterintelligence unit "specifically tasked with monitoring threats with Iran," days before the U.S. launched an attack against the country.

entries.title: More artists drop out of Ed Sheeran's tour in solidarity with rapper Macklemore
entries.snippet: Irish acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga, Denmark's Lukas Graham, and Finneas posted separately on social media that they would withdraw from the tour.

entries.title: WATCH: Steve Bannon says 'we have to rise' above partisanship to address AI 'hinge in history'
entries.snippet: Longtime Trump ally Steve Bannon doesn't always align himself with Sen. Bernie Sanders, the democratic socialist from Vermont. But on Tuesday he said threats posed by artificial intelligence span political ideology.

entries.title: Congressional Black Caucus launches effort to boost voting among Black, rural and young voters in midterms
entries.snippet: Organizers say they hope to boost turnout and influence closely divided House districts by focusing on voters' best interests.

entries.title: Belarus' authoritarian leader Lukashenko meets U.S. envoy to push for lifting remaining sanctions
entries.snippet: Since President Donald Trump returned to the White House, Lukashenko has released hundreds of political prisoners in a series of U.S.-mediated deals that also lifted some U.S. sanctions.

entries.title: WATCH: Blanche justifies Trump bashing Supreme Court over mail ballots: 'He is very frustrated'
entries.snippet: Attorney General Todd Blanche said Tuesday it was proper for President Donald Trump to vent about the Supreme Court decision to decline the changes that the president wanted for mail-in voting.

entries.title: WATCH: Patel explains why FBI no longer considers bestiality an automatic hiring disqualifier
entries.snippet: Patel said the change allows applications from people who have been victims of these crimes to be considered.

entries.title: Nick Reiner will not face death penalty over his parents' killings
entries.snippet: In a statement, his public defender said prosecutors had made the right decision and highlighted Reiner's mental illness and struggles with self-medication.

entries.title: Belarus to release 25 more prisoners as US eases sanctions
entries.snippet: Belarus will release 25 more prisoners under an interim agreement with the United States, while Washington plans to lift sanctions on two Belarusian companies and pursue broader negotiations.

entries.title: Congo's Ebola epidemic may have gone unnoticed for months
entries.snippet: The deadliest Ebola outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of Congo may have begun months before it was first declared in May.

entries.title: India news: US bill sanctioning Russia could hit India with tariffs of up to 100%
entries.snippet: A new bill could give President Trump the power to impose tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil and gas, potentially affecting major importer India. DW has more.

entries.title: Germany news: Conservative state premiers rally behind Merz
entries.snippet: All eight CDU state premiers have backed Friedrich Merz, urging the party to focus on rebuilding trust. Plus, Germany's coalition is weighing rapid relief as record fuel prices pile pressure on households. DW has more.

entries.title: Duterte makes first appearance before ICC judges
entries.snippet: Former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte appeared in person at the ICC as judges considered claims of memory impairment and poor health. The 81-year-old is accused of crimes against humanity.

entries.title: Germany's Chancellor Merz fighting for political survival
entries.snippet: Following the CDU's crushing defeat in the Saxony-Anhalt state election, many are expressing doubts about their party leader, Chancellor Friedrich Merz. But they don't appear to have any viable alternative.

entries.title: US charges 5 people over Russia-backed plots
entries.snippet: US prosecutors accuse the foreign nationals of conducting surveillance, attacks, and murder-for-hire operations for Moscow — just after a DW investigation identified one of the suspects as a salsa teacher in Russia.

entries.title: US announces South Africa visa curbs over race claims
entries.snippet: The visa restriction policy targets South African nationals who US Secretary of State Marco Rubio claims are responsible for "race-based discrimination" against white citizens.

entries.title: Global Gender Gap Report: Women's hard-won gains 'fragile'
entries.snippet: Two decades of progress toward gender parity is at risk as women's political representation declines, according to a new World Economic Forum report. At the current pace, the remaining gap could take 120 years to close.

entries.title: Kosovo ex-president Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
entries.snippet: A Hague tribunal ruled that Hashim Thaci, a former leader of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA), is responsible for war crimes carried out during the war of independence with Serbia.

entries.title: German drama 'Blindspot Berlin' revisits 2016 Christmas market attack
entries.snippet: A decade after the terrorist attack on a Berlin Christmas market, a new German miniseries looks into the institutional failures that allowed the deadly truck rampage to happen.

entries.title: Von der Leyen eyes Canada as EU's first 'associate member'
entries.snippet: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the EU and Canada saw the world with the same eyes. At her annual State of the Union address, she said the bloc was dealing with an "openly hostile world."

entries.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthis target Mecca, warns of 'red line'
entries.snippet: The Saudi-led coalition said its air defenses had destroyed a Houthi-deployed drone just outside Mecca, Islam's holiest city.

entries.title: How hotter weather is making us poorer
entries.snippet: Heat waves, wildfires and floods have cascading economic impacts, causing incomes to decline and the price of basic goods to rise. The trend will escalate as temperatures continue to increase.

entries.title: News helicopter crashes in LA, killing 3
entries.snippet: A helicopter belonging to an NBC news affiliate was covering a large traffic accident in the southern California city when it crashed. The cause is currently unclear.

entries.title: Supporting acts pull out of Ed Sheeran's tour over dropping Macklemore
entries.snippet: Macklemore was dropped over his pro-Palestinian stance, amid accusations of antisemitism. Sheeran said removing the artist was not his decision but that of the tour's promoters.

entries.title: AI leaders call for regulations, Trump dismisses 'hoaxes'
entries.snippet: AI giants are working to create a standards body amid rising alarms about the dangers of the industry. Meanwhile, Trump has dismissed the warnings, and a divided US Congress has failed to act.

entries.title: Turkey's rights groups, EU call out LGBTQ+ crackdown
entries.snippet: Several raids and arrests of LGBTQ+ persons in Turkey have triggered sharp criticism from numerous Turkish organizations — and also from Brussels.

entries.title: Drivers in Germany fume over soaring fuel prices
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz wants to provide relief to motorists. But exactly how this is to happen remains unclear.
